title: Beyond Simulation: Retain-and-Repair Neural Operators for Real-World Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39387v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators increasingly benefit from pretraining on numerical simulations, yet adapting them for real-world prediction remains challenging. We introduce the Retain-and-Repair Neural Operator (R$^2$NO), a framework for adapting simulation-pretrained operators to real-world data while retaining useful pretrained structure. The pretrained operator is first finetuned on real data and then frozen to provide a source prediction, and a shared repair module learns a sequence of refinements from the same observations. Using orthogonal Fourier projections, a spectral ensemble fits a small ridge regression within each cell of the Fourier domain and combines the refinements by weights fitted on a held-out split of the real data. The cells are defined jointly by radial ranges, angular sectors, and measured channels, allowing refinement depth to vary with frequency magnitude, with orientation, and across channels. translated_title: 超越仿真：面向真实世界适应的保留与修复神经算子
translated_abstract: 神经算子越来越受益于在数值仿真上的预训练，然而将其适配到真实世界预测仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了保留与修复神经算子（R²NO），这是一个在将仿真预训练算子适配到真实世界数据的同时保留有用预训练结构的框架。预训练算子首先在真实数据上进行微调，然后被冻结以提供源预测，同时一个共享的修复模块从相同的观测中学习一系列细化。利用正交傅里叶投影，一个频谱集成在傅里叶域的每个单元内拟合一个小型岭回归，并通过在真实数据留出集上拟合的权重来组合这些细化。这些单元由径向范围、角度扇区和测量通道共同定义，使得细化深度可以随频率幅值、方向以及跨通道而变化。将源预测纳入……
tldr: 提出R²NO框架，先在真实数据上微调并冻结预训练算子以提供源预测，再利用基于傅里叶域分区（径向、角度、通道）的频谱集成修复模块学习细化，从而在保留预训练结构的同时将仿真预训练的神经算子高效适配到真实世界数据。
